Before you start

  • You need a Windows PC, a legitimate installation of Among Us, and the game directory for the store version you use. TOHEE is host-only: the host installs it on a PC; other players do not need to install the mod.
  • Download the latest release package from TOHEE GitHub Releases. Do not download the source ZIP; it is not a runnable mod package.
  • Close Among Us before installing or updating. If the game directory already contains another mod or loader, prepare a clean game copy to avoid mixing plugins and BepInEx files.

Choose the package architecture

The current release instructions specify x64 packages for Steam, Epic Games, and Microsoft Store / Xbox App. The Windows itch.io client uses x86. An itch.io purchase may provide a Steam key; if you actually install and launch the Steam version, choose the x64 Steam package. Check each release's notes for its game-version and architecture requirements.

Install

  1. Find Among Us in Steam, Epic Games, Xbox App, or itch.io and open its installation directory. It should contain Among Us.exe.
  2. Close the game and extract all files from the release archive into the directory containing Among Us.exe. Keep folders such as BepInEx beside the game executable; do not install for the first time by copying only TOHE.dll.
  3. Launch the game using the method described in the store-specific notes below, then wait for the first load to finish. BepInEx generates interop files for this particular game installation on first launch and may need an internet connection to download components.
  4. Some loader or plugin versions may require a restart during first initialization; follow the instructions for the release package you downloaded.
  5. Check the main menu or mod version notice to confirm TOHEE loaded, then follow the room setup guide.

The release package contains the mod and loader, not the Among Us game. Do not copy an interop directory generated by another store installation; each game installation must generate its own files.

Store-specific notes

  • Steam: Put the files in Among Us's Steam library directory. You can launch through Steam or run Among Us.exe directly, but the signed-in Steam client must remain running in the background for game sign-in. The package includes steam_appid.txt for Steam.
  • Epic Games: Use the Epic installation directory and launch the game through Epic Games Launcher to sign in. Running Among Us.exe directly does not complete sign-in.
  • Xbox App / Microsoft Store: Use the directory containing that PC game's Among Us.exe and choose the x64 release package. This applies to the Windows PC game, not an Xbox console.
  • itch.io: Use the x86 package only for the Windows itch.io client. If itch.io supplied a Steam key and you installed through Steam, use the Steam x64 package instead.

Phones, tablets, and consoles cannot install this Windows mod, but may join a TOHE-hosted room when the game versions are compatible. Third-party Mod Manager installation steps on old upstream pages are not the current recommended installation flow; follow the current GitHub release package and its notes.

If the mod does not load, first check the game directory, architecture, and first-launch log, then see troubleshooting.
